name: Crawler
description: A small procedural creature that walks over a page's boxes while an agent works on it. Illustrative: it shows activity, not what the agent reads.

capabilities.label: Crawler on a page
capabilities.description: Show the crawler, a small creature that walks over a page while you work on it: on an HTML file published as an artifact (attach) or on a site open in your browser tab (site).

tools.description: Copy an HTML file (and the local files it links: styles, scripts, images) into a new folder with the crawler added, a small creature that walks over the page while you work. Publish the returned folder with the artifact tool (action publish, path = the folder) BEFORE you start the work, so the human watches it while you work; when stop_when_done is true also pass capabilities ["picode"] so the creature leaves when you finish. The creature is illustrative: never say it shows what you read. Returns the folder.

path.description: The HTML file: absolute, or relative to your working folder.

stop_when_done.description: Stop the creature when you stop working (default true). Needs capabilities ["picode"] at publish, which the human allows once.

highlights.description: Fill the boxes the creature stands on (default false). Leave it off for analysis work: a filled box reads as 'this was read'.

descend.description: Walk down the page, scrolling to follow (default false). Good for a long page such as a feed or a report.

tools.description: Put the crawler on the site open in your browser tab beside the human (the picode browser tool). Returns one JavaScript expression: pass it unchanged as the expression of your browser tool's evaluate verb, once per page. It is about 27 KB, so call this only when the human asks for the crawler on a site. A reload removes it; stop: true returns a short expression that removes it. It draws over the page and clicks nothing. Illustrative: never say it shows what you read.

descend.description: Walk down the page, scrolling to follow (default true).

highlights.description: Fill the boxes it stands on (default false).

root.description: A CSS selector for the part of the page to walk on, such as a results column (default: the whole page).

top.description: Scroll to the top of the page first (default false).

stop.description: Return the expression that removes the crawler instead.
